calculation.expression: -rolling_sum(pct_change(close), 3) when rolling_mean(20, cross_sectional_std(daily_returns)) exceeds its trailing 120-day median; cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: Fades the recent three-day move only during elevated cross-asset dispersion regimes, when reversal opportunities may be more differentiated; otherwise emits a neutral zero signal. All inputs are lagged to the decision-date completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily, 5-day, and 10-day predictive correlation across the 2020-2026 synthetic cross-asset history; conservative interpretation is warranted because the cross-section is only 15 instruments.
